meta.name: She Was Pretty
meta.description: A former ugly duckling tries to track down his childhood first love. But what will happen when a case of false identities backfires?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Hye-jin’s old friend Sung-joon wants to meet up with her. When he shows up looking unexpectedly handsome, Hye-jin asks Ha-ri to pretend to be her.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Hye-jin sees Sung-joon again when he joins her team as an editor at The Most magazine. Sung-joon scolds her harshly for her clumsiness.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Shin-hyuk notices there’s something going on between Hye-jin and Sung-joon. Tired of being looked down on, Hye-jin starts learning all about fashion.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Hye-jin calls Sung-joon after drinking to deal with his treatment of her. Ha-ri starts falling for Sung-joon as she continues meeting him as Hye-jin.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: On her day off, Hye-jin overhears Sung-joon talking on the phone about how The Most could cease publication unless performances improve.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Hye-jin worries about Sung-joon’s health. As he gets to know Ha-ri better, Sung-joon starts to notice that she is different from the Hye-jin he knew.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Sung-joon forgets his wallet when he gets lunch with Hye-jin while on assignment. They are put to work to earn back what they owe the restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Shin-hyuk tries to convince Ha-ri to stop pretending to be Hye-jin. Sung-joon struggles to deal with the feelings he has for both Hye-jin and Ha-ri.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Hye-jin’s colleagues marvel at her transformation when she returns to work. Shin-hyuk continues to tease Hye-jin as she and Sung-joon get closer.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Sung-joon rushes to Hye-jin’s side after her car breaks down. As he holds her tightly, he realizes just how much he cares about her.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Hye-jin and Sung-joon meet and catch up on all the things that have happened between them. Ha-ri’s mother comes to see her.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Sung-joon convinces Shin-hyuk to stay at The Most. Shin-hyuk returns back to work, but his feelings for Hye-jin remain unchanged.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Hye-jin starts seeing Sung-joon but his completely different attitude at work makes her worry that their colleagues will figure out what is happening.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: The Most’s big interview gets canceled at the last minute, but Poong-ho makes a brilliant suggestion of interviewing the famous writer Ten.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Sung-joon is shocked to learn Ten’s true identity. As Hye-jin prepares to move to America, a children’s book author invites her to work with her.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Sung-joon talks to Hye-jin every day since moving to America, while she starts writing children’s books. One day, Sung-joon stops answering his phone.

meta.slogan: Finding the sweet, thrilling, and hidden first love of four men and women
